name: Bamboovine
desc: Bamboovine (Smilax laurifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Smilax laurifolia is a species of flowering plant in the greenbrier family known by the common names laurel greenbrier, laurelleaf greenbrier, bamboo vine, and blaspheme vine.
